parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the pot, likely made of wood, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the container to protect its contents from dust, moisture, or contamination, and helps preserve freshness.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the pot.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pot, made of transparent glass, cylindrical in shape with a slightly flared rim.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents such as food, spices, or liquids, providing a sturdy and clean storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, only moved when the pot is relocated or cleaned.
